# GitHub Copilot — repository instructions

Read **`AGENTS.md`** at the root of this repository for:

- Comment conventions (boxed one-line “what” after functions; details below).
- XL type inference notes (`Types::Evaluate`, `IsEvalInProgress`, stale
  `rcalls`).
- Recorder trace flags and how tests under `tests/` are run.
- **Maintenance:** update `AGENTS.md` when the user adds important style or
  convention guidance, or corrects an assistant mistake (see “How to maintain”
  in that file).

Treat `AGENTS.md` as the primary project brief for assistants when it exists.
